question: In March 2025, Prime Minister of India announced that cheetah introduction will be expanded to Gandhisagar Sanctuary, which is in ________
solution: The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Gandhisagar Sanctuary** is located in the state of **Madhya Pradesh**, India. • It is situated on the **northern boundary of the Mandsaur and Neemuch districts** of Madhya Pradesh. • In **March 2025**, the Prime Minister of India announced the expansion of the **cheetah reintroduction program** to Gandhisagar Sanctuary as part of efforts to conserve and reintroduce cheetahs in India. • The cheetah reintroduction initiative was first launched in **Kuno National Park**, Madhya Pradesh, which is part of India’s commitment to global wildlife conservation and rewilding efforts. • The Gandhisagar Sanctuary is known for its diverse **flora and fauna** and is considered a suitable habitat for cheetahs due to its expansive grasslands and prey availability.
